name: Dacian Fortresses of the Orastie Mountains
description: In the forested Orăștie Mountains of central Romania, six hilltop strongholds once formed the heart of the Dacian kingdom under King Decebalus. Built about 2,000 years ago, they combine massive stone walls with sacred terraces and temples on high ridges. Sarmizegetusa Regia is the best known. The Romans took the fortresses in the early 2nd century AD.
